import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source3_28_0 and Source3_28_1 on "city"
# According to operation_history: JOIN : [["Source3_28_0", "Source3_28_1"], ["city", "city"]]
joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='inner', left_on='city', right_on='city')

# Operation 2: group_by = [Source3_28_0.city, Source3_28_0.driver_count, Source3_28_0.type]
# aggregations = [avg(Source3_28_1.fare), count(Source3_28_1.ride_id)]
grouped = (
    joined
    .groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False)
    .agg({'fare': 'mean', 'ride_id': 'count'})
)

# Rename columns to match target schema
grouped.rename(columns={
    'fare': 'Average Fare',
    'ride_id': 'Ride Count'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
grouped['city'] = grouped['city'].astype(str)
grouped['driver_count'] = grouped['driver_count'].astype(int)
grouped['type'] = grouped['type'].astype(str)
grouped['Average Fare'] = grouped['Average Fare'].astype(float)
grouped['Ride Count'] = grouped['Ride Count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='city', right_on='city')

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema)
# Aggregate average fare and count of ride_id
agg = joined.groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False).agg({
    'fare': 'mean',
    'ride_id': 'count'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
agg.rename(columns={'fare': 'Average Fare', 'ride_id': 'Ride Count'}, inplace=True)

# Write output to target file
